finding: The study found a high prevalence of caesarean sections in Brazil (55.5%) was associated with increased rates of preterm and early-term births.
mod_finding: The adjusted prevalence ratios of preterm and early-term birth were higher in municipalities with high CS rates compared to those with low CS rates.
gest_age: Preterm (<37 weeks), Early-term (37-38 weeks), Full-term (39-41 weeks), Post-term (42 or more weeks)
